description: This file defines the 'network_map' class within the 'son' namespace. It declares static methods for managing and transmitting network map data and various related messages, primarily for a Wi-Fi mesh network controller. The class interacts with a database, constructs messages, and sends events to listeners.

classes.name: network_map
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for network map data management and communication in the Wi-Fi mesh controller.

methods.name: send_bml_network_map_message
methods.description: Sends a network map message constructed from the database to a specified file descriptor.

methods.name: fill_bml_node_data
methods.description: Fills a buffer with data about a network node identified by its MAC address, potentially forcing client disconnection.

methods.name: fill_bml_station_data
methods.description: Fills a buffer with data about a specific station object, with an option to force disconnection.

methods.name: fill_bml_agent_data
methods.description: Fills a buffer with data about an agent object, optionally forcing disconnection.

methods.name: send_bml_nodes_statistics_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Sends nodes statistics messages to a list of listeners, filtered by valid hostaps.

methods.name: fill_bml_radio_statistics
methods.description: Fills a buffer with radio statistics for a given radio agent.

methods.name: fill_bml_station_statistics
methods.description: Fills a buffer with statistics for a station.

methods.name: send_bml_event_to_listeners
methods.description: Broadcasts an event message to a list of listeners.

methods.name: send_bml_bss_tm_req_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Sends a BSS TM request message to listeners targeting a specific BSSID.

methods.name: send_bml_bh_roam_req_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Sends a backbone roam request message to listeners for a given BSSID and channel.

methods.name: send_bml_client_allow_req_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Requests clients to be allowed on the network by sending messages to listeners.

methods.name: send_bml_client_disallow_req_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Requests disallowing clients from the network.

methods.name: send_bml_acs_start_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Sends an ACS start message to listeners for a specific host access point.

methods.name: send_bml_csa_notification_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Sends a Channel Switch Announcement notification to listeners.

methods.name: send_bml_cac_status_changed_notification_message_to_listeners
methods.description: Sends a notification of CAC (Channel Access Control) status change.
